藏经阁残简 第十五章 夜探废书坪暗收遗珍（第1页）
暮色彻底吞没青云仙宗的群山，一轮残月悬于墨色天幕，淡淡清辉洒落在藏书阁后院。
刘松离开后，阁楼之中只剩沈砚一人。他静静立在书架之间，脑海反复回想方才管事所言，明日一早便要将后院废书堆全部运去焚书台焚毁。
那一堆看似毫无价值的朽简里，还混杂着数卷带有微弱道韵的古籍，若是真的付之一炬，失传的文脉便会永久消散，实在可惜。
于旁人而言只是废纸，于手握残简道藏的他，却是不可多得的修行资源。
“趁着今夜无人，去一趟后院废书坪。”
如今道基圆满，凝气七层巅峰修为深藏体内，就算途中偶遇巡逻弟子，凭《破妄文章》勘破周遭动静，也能轻松避开，不会暴露自身异样。
他抬手将顶层所有修复完毕的残简妥善收好在自己储物布袋，又整理了一番身上灰旧杂役长袍，将周身灵气尽数收敛，化作平日里羸弱普通的模样，轻手轻脚走下木质阶梯。
整座西藏书阁此刻早已安静下来，值守的杂役早已回到偏房歇息，长廊内唯有夜风穿窗的轻响。沈砚脚步放轻，借着廊柱阴影遮掩身形，一路畅通无阻走到后院。
白日里整齐码放的废简堆静静躺在空地上，残月微光落在层层竹简之上，空气中弥漫着腐朽竹木与陈旧墨汁混合的气息。
四下张望一圈，四周山道寂静，不见巡逻弟子的身影。沈砚快步走到废简堆旁，指尖轻轻搭在最外层一卷残破竹简之上。
《破妄文章》悄然运转，一双慧眼穿透厚厚的竹层，瞬间分辨出哪些竹简内藏有道韵，哪些只是纯粹朽烂的空竹。
短短片刻，他便精准筛选出七八卷被埋没其中的残简，有低阶吐纳心法残篇，还有一卷残缺的草木丹方，都是如今宗门藏书楼不曾留存的古法。
沈砚不动声色，将这些珍贵残卷悄悄塞进自己随身布袋，剩余毫无价值的空简分毫未动，依旧维持原本堆放的模样，就算明日刘松带人前来检查，也看不出半点异样。
做完这一切，他并未立刻折返顶层阁楼，而是缓步走到废书坪边缘，抬眼望向远处青云主峰。
夜色之下，主峰一座座长老殿的轮廓若隐若现，哪怕隔着遥远距离，他依旧能透过虚妄，看见殿宇缝隙间缠绕的丝丝缕缕域外黑气。
这些黑气潜藏宗门多年，潜移默化侵染弟子心神，扭曲道念，陆明远便是被黑气侵蚀心智的最好例子。
若是任由这种情况持续下去，不出数十年，青云仙宗的文脉根基便会被彻底腐蚀，到那时整片玄洲大陆都会陷入巨大危机。

“当务之急，先积累足够底蕴，拥有直面长老的实力，再徐徐探查域外黑暗的源头。”
眼下他仅有凝气七层巅峰修为，面对拥有凝气九层的刘松尚可周旋，可对上那些修为抵达筑基境的长老，依旧没有半分胜算，贸然探寻黑暗源头只会引火烧身。
唯有不断修复古籍，汲取上古道韵，稳步提升修为，夯实自身根基，才有资本拨开笼罩宗门的层层迷雾。
一阵夜风掠过，吹动满地竹简簌簌轻响，远处山门方向传来几声巡逻弟子的交谈声，正朝着后院这边靠近。
沈砚眼神微凝，不再停留，转身顺着原路快步返回顶层阁楼。
推开阁楼木门，将布袋里方才收来的残简一一取出，平铺在木桌之上。
指尖触碰残简，金色道纹悄然从他掌心流淌而出，开始修复这些险些被焚毁的古籍。
温和醇厚的道韵顺着指尖涌入经脉，滋养本就圆满无瑕的道基，丹田内的灵气愈发凝练纯粹。
沈砚盘膝坐在桌前，一边修复残卷，一边静心消化道韵带来的修为增益，心中已然期待明日重返下层藏书阁。
下层库房之中，还有大量常年封存、无人问津的老旧典籍，那又是一片等待他发掘的文脉宝库。
隐忍蛰伏的日子不会持续太久，等他搜刮完整座西阁所有残简，修为再进一步，便是时候不用再刻意伪装，直面所有欺辱算计自己之人。

Chapter 15 of the Fragments of the Sutra Pavilion: Visiting the Abandoned Book Ping at Night to Secretly Collect Treasures (Page 1)
The twilight completely engulfed the mountains of Qingyun Immortal Sect, and a waning moon hung in the dark sky, with a faint light shining in the backyard of the library.
After Liu Song left, Shen Yan was the only one left in the attic. He stood quietly among the bookshelves, thinking over and over again in his mind what the manager had just said, that tomorrow morning all the waste books in the backyard would be transported to the book burning table to be burned.
Among the seemingly worthless piles of decayed slips, there are also several volumes of ancient books with weak Taoist charms mixed in. If they are really burned, the lost context will disappear forever, which is a pity.
To others it is just waste paper, but to him holding the broken Taoist treasure, it is a rare resource for practice.
"While there is no one around tonight, go to the waste book terrace in the backyard."
Now that the Dao Foundation is perfect and the peak cultivation level of the seventh level of Qi Condensation is hidden deep in the body, even if you encounter patrolling disciples on the way, you can easily avoid them by relying on the "Poller Article" to detect the surrounding movements without exposing yourself.
He raised his hand and put all the repaired fragments on the top floor into his storage bag. He also tidied up his old gray handyman robes, gathered all the spiritual energy around him, and turned into his usual frail and ordinary appearance. He walked down the wooden stairs lightly.
The entire Tibetan Book Pavilion had already quieted down at this moment, and the handymen on duty had already returned to the side room to rest. The only sound in the corridor was the gentle sound of the night wind passing through the windows. Shen Yan walked lightly, using the shadow of the pillars to cover his figure, and walked to the backyard unimpeded.
During the day, piles of discarded slips neatly stacked lay quietly on the open ground. The dim light of the waning moon fell on the layers of bamboo slips, and the air was filled with the smell of decaying bamboo and old ink.
Looking around, the surrounding mountain roads were quiet, and there were no patrolling disciples in sight. Shen Yan quickly walked to the pile of scrap slips and gently placed his fingertips on the outermost roll of broken bamboo slips.
The "Polu Article" operates quietly. A pair of discerning eyes penetrates the thick layer of bamboo and instantly distinguishes which bamboo slips contain Taoist rhyme and which ones are just rotten diabolo.
In just a short moment, he accurately sifted out seven or eight volumes of fragments buried among them, including fragments of low-level breathing techniques, and a fragmented volume of herbal elixirs, all of which were ancient techniques that had not been preserved in the sect's library today.
Shen Yan calmly stuffed these precious scraps into his pocket. The remaining worthless scrolls remained untouched and remained in their original stacked appearance. Even if Liu Song brought someone to inspect them tomorrow, nothing would be found out of the ordinary.
After doing all this, he did not immediately return to the top attic. Instead, he walked slowly to the edge of Waste Books Ping and looked up at the main Qingyun Peak in the distance.
Under the night, the outlines of the elders' palaces on the main peak were looming. Even from a long distance, he could still see through the illusion the strands of extraterrestrial black energy entwined in the gaps between the palaces.
This black energy has been hiding in the sect for many years, subtly infecting the minds of disciples and distorting Taoism. Lu Mingyuan is the best example of a mind that has been eroded by black energy.
If this situation is allowed to continue, within a few decades, the cultural foundation of the Qingyun Immortal Sect will be completely corroded, and by then the entire Xuanzhou Continent will be in a huge crisis.
"The top priority is to first accumulate enough knowledge and have the strength to face the elders directly, and then slowly explore the source of darkness outside the territory."
At present, he only has the peak cultivation level of the seventh level of Qi Condensation. He can still deal with Liu Song, who has the ninth level of Qi Condensation level. However, he still has no chance of winning against those elders who have reached the foundation building level. Rushing to explore the source of darkness will only lead to fire.
Only by constantly repairing ancient books, absorbing the charm of ancient Taoism, steadily improving your cultivation, and consolidating your own foundation can you have the capital to clear away the layers of fog that shrouds the sect..
A gust of night wind blew past, making a soft rustling sound on the bamboo slips all over the ground. In the distance, from the direction of the mountain gate, there were several conversations of patrolling disciples approaching the backyard.
Shen Yan's eyes narrowed slightly, no longer stopping, he turned around and quickly returned to the top attic along the original path.
Pushing open the wooden door of the attic, he took out the scraps he had just collected from the cloth bag one by one, and spread them flat on the wooden table.
His fingertips touched the broken scrolls, and golden Dao lines quietly flowed out of his palms, and he began to repair these ancient books that were almost burned.
The gentle and mellow Taoist rhyme flows into the meridians along the fingertips, nourishing the already perfect and flawless Taoist foundation, and the spiritual energy in the Dantian becomes more condensed and pure.
Shen Yan sat cross-legged at the table, repairing the broken scrolls and quietly digesting the cultivation gains brought by Tao Yun. He was already looking forward to returning to the lower library tomorrow.
In the lower warehouse, there are also a large number of old classics that have been sealed for many years and no one cares about them. It is another treasure house of cultural context waiting for him to discover.
The days of concealment and dormancy will not last long. When he has searched all the remnants of the West Pavilion and has further improved his cultivation, it will be time to stop pretending and face all those who bully and plot against him.
